about: What the schema SQL can't say about an element: what it means, its grain where no key states it, its other names, its tags, how long it lives and how it grows. Merged over the generated descriptors by modules/elements (packages/si-elements merge). Keys are element ids; unknown ids are reported. Tags are namespace:value (domain, pii, layer, storage).

table:users.description: Accounts: a username and password hash, with an optional display name and an admin flag.

pass_hash.description: scrypt hash of the password; never the password itself.

username.description: The name a person signs in with; unique ignoring case.

display_name.description: How the name is shown (extended version).

table:sessions.description: Signed-in sessions: a random token in a cookie, its user and when it expires.

lifecycle.retention: until expires_at; expired rows are deleted on sign-in

table:sources.description: Where stories come from: a feed or page, its format, schedule and fetch health.

interval_minutes.description: How often to fetch it, in minutes.

etag.description: The ETag from the last response, for conditional fetches.

last_modified.description: The Last-Modified header from the last response, for conditional fetches.

verified.description: Flag: the feed was checked to parse.

from_catalog.description: Flag: added from the admin source catalog.

table:stories.description: One story on the homepage: a piece of AI-progress news grouped across the sources that carried it, with its tags, analysis and significance score.

grain.statement: one row per grouped story (all links to the same item share one row; see story_keys)

lifecycle.retention: pruned by the harvester to stay inside Neon Free

authors.description: Authors as the source gave them (text); never claims about them.

ext_score.description: A score from the source itself where it has one (points, upvotes), else 0.

hidden.description: Flag: hidden from the feed by an admin.

analysis.description: The analysis behind the score and tags, as JSON text.

table:story_keys.description: Grouping keys (canonical URL, arXiv id, DOI, title fingerprint) that map to one story, so a second link to the same item joins it.

table:story_links.description: Each link to a story from a source: the same story carried by several sources has several links.

rigor.description: The rigor badge for this link's source, if any.

table:story_topics.description: Which ontology topics a story is tagged with, one row per tag, for filtering.

table:votes.description: A person's upvote on a story.

table:saves.description: A story a person saved for later.

table:notes.description: A person's note on a story, private unless they share it (extended version).

grain.statement: one row per note (a person may write several notes on one story)

table:lists.description: Reading lists a person curates (extended version).

table:list_items.description: Stories on a reading list, with an optional note.

table:follows.description: A person following someone's reading list.

table:agent_log.description: Old in-app agent log entries, kept only so they survive; the agent log is now AGENT_LOG.md (REQ-020).

table:agent_log_saves.description: Edit history of the legacy agent log entries (how much was typed or pasted per save).

grain.statement: one row per save of an entry

table:fetch_runs.description: One fetch of one source: when, how it ended, how many items it found and stored.

grain.statement: one row per fetch of a source

table:admin_audit.description: Every admin action and data action: who, what, on which target, with a short detail.

target.description: What the action was on (source:12, action:responses.build, ...).

table:story_entities.description: Numbers and entities found in a story (a benchmark and its reported score, with its unit), for the capability tracker.

entity.description: The entity's qualified id (a benchmark, an organisation).

table:appearance_settings.description: Site appearance and feature switches, one value per key (theme, layout, feature flags).

value.description: The setting's value as JSON text.

updated_by.description: The admin who last changed it.

table:data_artifacts.description: Versioned artifacts the site generates (a paper response, a draft), one row per artifact with its current version.

table:data_artifact_versions.description: Each saved version of an artifact: its body, files, note and who saved it.

table:data_kg_snapshots.description: The knowledge graph as N-Quads, one snapshot per named store, with a version so instances stay in step.

table:editorial_posts.description: Editorial posts (journal entries) with a draft and a published revision.

table:editorial_revisions.description: Each revision of an editorial post and the action that made it.

table:knowledge_chunks.description: Text chunks of stories with their tags and embedding vectors, for retrieval.

table:knowledge_edges.description: Weighted, evidenced edges between knowledge nodes (src rel dst).

evidence.description: Why the edge exists (the text or source behind it), as JSON text.

table:lab_runs.description: Results of Lab toy checks: which example, which metric, its value and result.

grain.statement: one row per run of a Lab check

table:lab_policies.description: Policies the Lab proposed or adopted, with their measured accuracy and properties.

table:learn_jobs.description: Learn studio jobs (explainers, videos, proofs, paper responses) queued for the local worker, with their output.

concept_id.description: The Learn concept the job is about, if any.

output.description: The job's output text or a summary of it.

table:project_issues.description: Project tracker issues with status, priority, assignee and milestone.

table:project_activity.description: History of changes to project issues.

grain.statement: one row per change to an issue

table:project_deps.description: Which project issue depends on which; must form a DAG.

table:responses_papers.description: Paper responses: the latest package (analysis, plan, article) for each paper; versions live in data_artifacts.

table:review_docs.description: Reviewed papers, articles and comments with their evidence scores and an optional human label.

table:review_events.description: Dated forecast records found in reviewed documents, to check when they fall due (never attributed to a person).

table:work_claims.description: Claims by people and agents on tasks and files, as leases that run out.

grain.statement: one row per claim (renewals update it)

lifecycle.retention: released and expired claims pruned after 30 days

task.description: The claimed task's key (spec:006/T673, change:<id>/1.1, response:<slug>).

actor.description: Who holds it: person:<username> or agent:<name>.

branch.description: The git branch the work is on.

intent.description: What the holder means to do.

asked_by.description: The person who asked an agent to do it.

table:work_advice.description: Whether a person accepted or dismissed each advisor suggestion.

grain.statement: one per tag on one story
one per story judged for scope
one per chunk of a story's text

table:review_blind.description: Blind labels: whether a person would rely on a reviewed piece, given before seeing the judge's verdict (one per person per piece; the first answer stands).
